suite: voice transcript visibility + stale gateway fix
problemReportedByUser: 似乎没有真实接入 DSH；以及说一句话文字没显示好就立马调整了

rootCauses.staleGateway: A voice gateway orphaned by an earlier crashed/killed shell kept the qwen instance lease. The next shell's gateway then exited immediately with code 0 ('Gateway 已在运行'), so /bot/status showed gateway=false and the voice path looked dead.
rootCauses.transcriptSwallowed: The pet treated the renderer's recognition bubble as transient: on recognition end it called hideBubble immediately, so the recognised sentence vanished before the reply/turn replaced it (it looked like the text was never shown).

fixes.staleGateway: bot-runtime.start now stops a stale qwen gateway listening on the voice port before spawning its own (lsof + ps guard, SIGTERM).
fixes.transcriptDisplay: pet main keeps the final transcript as a grey input bubble (💬 你说：…) when recognition ends; it stays until the DSH turn/activity bubble replaces it.
fixes.bridgeText: host integration now includes the user's text in the user.message bridge event (bounded), so the pet/evidence can show exactly what DSH received.
